ABOUT US

A note from the Owner

Siddhi Motors is an automobile spare parts supplier based in Birgunj, Parsa, supplying parts for cars, pickups and commercial vehicles, with delivery all over Nepal. Our owner, Mr Dilip Sah Kanu, brings more than 20 years of experience gained before Siddhi Motors.

Dear Valued Customer,

Thank you for choosing Siddhi Motors. From our base in Birgunj, we supply spare parts for cars, pickups and commercial vehicles. If you cannot find the part you need, or want help confirming the right fit for your vehicle, please call or email us. We are always happy to help.

We value your trust and look forward to serving you.

Mr Dilip Sah Kanu

FAQ

Common questions

 

How do I know which part fits my vehicle?

Tell us your vehicle make, model and year, or bring the old part to our shop. We will help you confirm the right fit before you buy.

Can I get prices online?

Please call 9845024689 or 9815271503, or email us, and we will share current prices and availability.

Which vehicles do you cover?

Cars, pickups and commercial vehicles, including Tata Ace, Tata Magic, Mahindra Maximo and Ashok Leyland Dost, with parts for Tata, Mahindra, Bosch and TVS vehicles and systems.

Do you deliver outside Birgunj?

Yes. We deliver all over Nepal under an IRD certified VCTS. Tell us your town or district when you enquire and we will confirm the delivery details.

Which payment methods do you accept?

We accept Cash, Bank Transfer, eSewa and Cheque. We do not accept cards.

How can I order?

By phone, email or in person at our Birgunj shop.
